_doc: Simulated ToF quality (v3_marker tof_sim_model.py, 2026-10-31). Generic PMD-style values until the real sensor is measured (plans/2026-10-31_real_sensor_check_plan.md section C); then replace the numbers here. Applied by wall_sense.py when WK_TOF_MODEL points to this file.
_noise: depth noise sd = noise_sd0 + noise_sd_rel * depth (m), on top of the gz sensor's own 5 mm
_amp: returned signal ~ reflectivity * cos(incidence) / depth^2; a pixel is kept when cos(incidence) / depth^2 >= 1 / amp_range_m^2 (stands in for the confidence cutoff 125 of voxl-vision-hub): straight-on surfaces are seen to amp_range_m, a 75 deg grazing view only to ~half of it
_amp_soft: pixels within this fraction above the cutoff are dropped at random with a probability falling linearly to 0 (a ragged edge, not a hard line)
_edge: flying pixels: a pixel whose 4-neighbour depth jumps by more than edge_jump_m is replaced, with edge_mix_prob, by a convex mix of its own and that neighbour's depth (uniform between the near and far surface; 2026-11-01 codex tof-edge-model: before, d + U(0,1)*|jump|*random sign, which went past both surfaces). After the model, depth <= 0 or range > max_range_m = no return (inf)
